profile.headline: Software Engineer - Founder at RadStack
profile.summary:
I am a senior software engineer, focused on delivering quality software solutions. I have designed solutions for businesses of all sizes, managed a development team, provided analysis for customers. I am currently proficient in Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, Angular, Javascript, CSS and most anything related to full stack web development.
 
Languages : 
Ruby, Typescript, Javascript, CSS, HTML, LessCSS, HAML, Java, SQL

Frameworks :
Rails, Bootstrap, Angular, 

Integrations : 
Stripe, Twilio, GoogleMaps, Google Calendar, Docusign

Tools : 
GIT, JIRA, Jenkins, Codeship, Bitbucket, GitHub, Heroku, Postgres

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working with a dedicated team of Ruby on Rails developer to create customized business applications that help our customers increase efficiency and scale their business operations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I was the lead developer and architect on a project that converted a very complex query building tool from a legacy Flex Flash UI framework to a modern Angular UI framework.

-  Implemented a system that allows building of feature branches that can be tested in isolation from the main branch. This allows developers to continue to developing software features without holding up releases of versions and gives flexibility to develop features over longer periods of time

- Coordinated and implemented the migration of large code base from a legacy version control system to GIT and hooked up to BitBucket

- Other responsibilities included : Software development frontend/backend (Java framework), Dev ops work with Linux and Jenkins environment, mentoring of other developers

positions.title: Co Founder and Director of Engineering
positions.description:
Development manager for a Ruby on Rails, iOS, and Android shop, with a team size of up to 5 developers. Responsible for :
    - Facilitating an agile scrum workflow
    - Mentoring developers
    - Analyzing business needs of customers and creating software solutions
    - Managing project deadlines and completion
    - Providing Customer support and relations
    - Coding software solutions
Contributed to managing IT solutions used by the organization including : 
   - JIRA administration and configuration
   - Setting up and configuring development tools ( GitHub, Codeship, Heroku )

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Engineer for Pace, a web application used to manage medium size print shops ( accounting, inventory, fulfillment, estimating. )
Responsible for :
   - Creating enhancements ( Java server side )
   - Fixing bugs ( Java server side )
   - Creating Integration tests
   - Leading frontend development

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for :
   - Enhancing and modifying internal tools, using PHP, Perl, HTML and Javascript
   - Customizing internal and customer screens, with XML form design tools
   - Working with basic Java server side enhancement and bugs

positions.title: President
positions.description: This is my own company that is used to provide web site design and web site management services. I am in charge of everything including, design, client interaction, billing, delegation of work to contractors.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: Designed the layout for the school wide newspaper. We had two issues published per month. I was also the managing editor which meant I helped in the deciding of content for each issue and was in charge of contacting resources such as photographers and writers and making sure they have their work done on time.
